Contacting me

The project brief form runs in your browser and prepares an email in your email application. The form itself does not send or store your details on this website. You choose whether to send the email. Email, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn enquiries are handled through those services.

Site features

This site does not add analytics trackers, advertising scripts, or application cookies. Hosting providers may process ordinary request information to serve and protect the website. The font and visual assets are hosted with the site.

External websites

Project links, archive references, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp take you to external services with their own privacy practices. Historical project references describe earlier contributions and may differ from the current state of those websites.

Contact

For questions about the website or information presented here, email brajkishorpandey@gmail.com.
